item.title: ‘We’re going to win. We have no other choice’
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told the UN General Assembly that Israel’s strikes on Iran are a matter of national survival. He dismissed West Bank violence as the work of a handful of juvenile delinquents and called accusations of genocide in Gaza the greatest lie of the century. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu used his address to the UN General Assembly to defend Israel’s strikes against Iran as a matter of national survival and describe the violence in the West Bank as the work of few “juvenile delinquents” and reject accusations of genocide in Gaza as “the greatest lie of the century.”.

item.title: Palestinian existence under threat, Abbas tells UN, warning of ‘another Nakba’
item.description: Israeli policies now threaten “the very life and existence of the Palestinian people on their homeland”, Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas told the UN General Assembly on Thursday, urging the world not to allow “another Nakba”. Palestinian existence under threat, Abbas tells UN, warning of ‘another Nakba’.

item.title: World leaders approve new declaration to tackle rising sea levels
item.description: Sea level rise is among the most visible consequences of global warming, but for some countries, it is an imminent existential threat. World leaders meet Thursday to adopt a new declaration and debate the best ways to strengthen international cooperation and support vulnerable low-lying nations most at risk. World leaders tackle sea level rise, a stark marker of climate change.

item.title: US Pushes To Turn Armenia-Azerbaijan Transit Deal Into Investment Opportunity
item.description: The Trump administration is trying to turn a US-brokered opening between Armenia and Azerbaijan into something more tangible: a transport corridor linking Central Asia and the South Caucasus with Western markets -- and an investment opportunity for American companies.
